response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId) SELECT MediaTypeId, avg_price, avg_price / (SELECT AVG(avg_price) FROM per_type) AS ratio_to_baseline FROM per_type ORDER BY ratio_to_baseline DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Only media types that have at least one track appear (derived from Track), since averages are computed over Track rows; media types with no tracks are excluded from both output and the baseline.
The baseline is the unweighted mean of per-media-type averages, as the request specifies, not the overall track-level average.
Ties in ratio are broken arbitrarily since no tiebreaker was specified.
